name: Eye Juice
storyline:
The story takes place in the near future, in the year 203X. Something strange is happening in City X. There's complete silence on the internet and radio.
The main character is a secret service agent who needs to find out what's going on and save the world. Before all these events, a strange corporation appeared in the city, producing soda.
summary: This WAD is themed around urban environments: large and small cities and suburbs, industrial facilities, shops and malls.
